sentences.text: Costa Rica is a small country in Central America.
It has many beautiful animals and big forests.
Many people travel to Costa Rica every year.
They want to see nature.
This special kind of travel is called ecotourism.
Ecotourism means you travel and you help the place you visit.
It helps protect nature and all its animals.
In the past, some people cut down many trees.
This was a big problem for the animals.
Their homes were gone.
Now, ecotourism helps to change this.
When tourists visit, they spend money in the country.
This money helps pay for national parks.
National parks are very large, safe areas for wildlife.
Because of tourism, Costa Rica has more parks now.
The parks are bigger than before, and they protect more land.
Ecotourism also creates jobs for local people.
People can work as tour guides.
They show tourists the monkeys and the birds.
Other people work in small hotels or restaurants.
They do not need to cut trees for money anymore.
Instead, they can protect the forest.
They know the forest is more important.
It brings visitors and helps their families have a better life.
Tourists can see amazing animals in Costa Rica.
In the forest, you can see monkeys and sloths in the trees.
You can see colorful birds like toucans.
On the coast, you can watch sea turtles.
They come to the beaches to lay their eggs.
But tourists must follow rules.
You should always stay on the paths.
You must not touch the wild animals.
You should not feed them, because it is bad for their health.
This is very important.
It keeps the animals wild and safe.
Ecotourism is very good for Costa Rica.
It helps the animals, the forests, and the people.
When tourists choose ecotourism, they make a good choice.
They learn about nature and help protect it for the future.
This good travel means everyone can enjoy Costa Rica’s beauty for a long, long time.
